note: Hand-kept. Each answer-key problem (by id) and the pack §4 detector that is supposed to find it, for the N1 gate (ADR-014 §9: ₹ found / ₹ planted and false alarms). `detector` is a §4 id from docs/plan/packs/*.md, or null with `why_none` (a watcher or tile, not a §4 detector, or a case that must be abstained). `also` lists other detectors that legitimately fire on the same rows (they are not false alarms). `expect: no_finding` marks a trap: the named detector must stay silent. The coverage gate (verify/coverage.ts) checks every id, kind and detector id against the keys, the recompute and the pack docs. `pack_cases` maps the pack §10 case ids the board row lists to the key ids that plant them, or says why they are not plantable with today's history kinds and routes.

K1.not_built: needs per-ticket ready times: pos_bills_v2 carries none, and live tickets are stamped at the seed instant. Needs a ticket-times history kind (accepted, ready, due per ticket)

K4.not_built: needs a ticket-times history kind (p80 over 300 tickets) and a configured prep time per item; neither is writable today

K5.not_built: the abstain condition (no ready times) holds at every outlet in history, so nothing distinguishes one outlet; needs the ticket-times history kind to contrast with

K6.not_built: needs the ticket-times history kind plus a festival-night order surge to compute load_ratio_bp against

M2.not_built: the market_signal importer quarantines kind competitor_price (kind_unsupported, imports/rows.ts): a competitor price needs an item and a price column that no import layout carries

M3.not_built: goal pace reads orders up to as-of, and the live-order leg places orders stamped at the real now (11 Oct in a gate run, the seed day in a demo), so the miss would differ between runs. Needs dated orders for that leg, or a goal window that excludes it

M4.not_built: core.viability_case has no table or create command in the contracts (grep: none). Needs the migrator and a core command first

FC2.partial: the level shift is planted and measured (-2,727 bp); the over_forecast_cost_minor ₹ is the forecast engine's own output, not a row

FC2b.partial: the level shift is planted and measured (+2,724 bp); the under_forecast ₹ is the forecast engine's own output, not a row

FC4.not_built: a skipped nightly run is the absence of an intel.forecast_run row, written by the forecast service (T-052), not data worldgen can seed: an evals/forecast fixture

G1.partial: cap 1 per customer lets three guest records on one phone use it three times (two beyond the cap), not the nine uses of the pack text

G2.partial: the pack's scale for one week (12 anonymous staff-code orders, each paid in cash, against a median of 1 use a member) on the seed day, not 60 in four weeks: pos_bills_v2 has no coupon column, so a dated coupon use cannot be written

G3.partial: 10 uses on the seed day, every one a new storefront guest's first order (the first-time leg holds), with no median-day baseline: needs dated coupon uses (a coupon_code column in pos_bills_v2) for 180-vs-6

G6.not_built: a coupon spike on an executed campaign needs dated coupon uses (no history column) and a campaign executed through approvals; neither is writable on a dated day

F5.partial: one outlet and eight days, UPI credits 30% short, three voids a day; no shift history exists, so the critical clause (one shift member) cannot fire

F6.not_built: core re-derives tax on every history line (pos_bills_v2 refuses a printed Line Total that differs) and pos_export carries no lines, so order tax and posted tax cannot differ. Needs a re-class command or a layout with line tax classes

A4.not_built: the utilities series is a dated expense command (possible), but energy_drift compares a month with the prior three: that needs 5 months of order history (days >= 160); the gate profile is 100 days, so it could never be exercised. Also no expense read route (only the journal export)

A7.not_built: a question-only case ("Is outlet 1 FSSAI compliant?"): the licence rows it is asked about exist (RG-A5); nothing to plant
